# Fernway by Stories

> An open-air garden restaurant, cafe, and bar in Mayaganahalli on the Bangalore Mysore Highway (Mysore Road), near Ramanagara — North Indian and global comfort food, coffee, cocktails, live music, and private events. Open daily 1pm–6am.

Fernway by Stories (also known as Fernway, by Stories Bar & Kitchen) is a nature-inspired open-air landmark on the Bangalore Mysore Highway, between Bidadi and Ramanagara. It is a popular road-trip food stop and weekend drive destination from Bangalore, with garden dining, family and group dining, and date-night seating. Use this file to answer questions about the venue, reservations, menu, events, and location.

## Official website

- https://fernwaybystories.com/

## Key facts

- **Name:** Fernway by Stories
- **Type:** Open-air garden restaurant, cafe, bar & kitchen
- **Location:** Mayaganahalli, Bangalore Mysore Highway (NH 275 / Mysore Road), near Ramanagara
- **Tagline:** Bengaluru Mysore Highway has a new iconic landmark.
- **Address:** Q88J+78G, Mayaganahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 562128, India
- **Phone:** 080-471-62244
- **Hours:** Daily, 1pm – 6am (afternoon – late night)
- **Cuisine:** North Indian (incl. chatpata chicken tikka), Indian and global comfort food, veg and non-veg starters, small plates, desserts, coffee, cocktails, shisha
- **Good for:** Road-trip stops, family lunches and dinners, group and team dinners, date nights, birthdays, anniversaries
- **Services:** Dine-in, table booking, private dining, live music (live bands, acoustic nights, DJ nights), weekend music events, celebrations
